summary: ASTRA-001 evidence_hashes.json was written as two concatenated JSON arrays with a UTF-8 BOM; REQUEST_LEDGER.json also carried a BOM. Additionally an earlier RETRY_ANALYSIS.md write failed with an unterminated-string JSON parse error, and the first draft of tests/test_astra001.py raised SyntaxError from backslash escapes in a non-raw docstring.
root_cause: Artifact writes used PowerShell-style multi-array dumps and BOM-prefixed encoding without a single-JSON-doc validation step; docstring paths were not raw strings.
what_i_did_wrong: Failed to validate each written JSON artifact as a single parseable document immediately after write; wrote a non-raw docstring containing Windows paths.
detection: Close-out verification: json.load raised 'Unexpected UTF-8 BOM' and 'Unexpected data' (two arrays); test run raised SyntaxError unicodeescape; one unittest regex mismatch on backtick-quoted `0`.
corrective_action: Merged hashes file into one valid JSON list (7 entries) and revalidated; loaded ledger with utf-8-sig; converted test docstring to raw string; relaxed never-zero regex to tolerate `0` backticks.
recurrence_prevention: After any JSON write, immediately json.load the file; use utf-8 (no BOM) and a single top-level document; use r-docstrings for paths.
